name: The Relics of Wakening
summary: At Ban'ethil Barrow Den, an urgent effort is underway to save the sleeping Druids of the Talon. Corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun the sacred mounds, threatening the druids whose spirits wander the Emerald Dream. Four ritual relics are needed to bring the sleepers safely back to the waking world.

sections.title: A Sanctum Defiled
sections.body: West of Dolanaar, a swarm of corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs has overrun the winding corridors of Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Barrow dens are secluded sanctuaries where night elf druids hibernate while their spirits walk the Emerald Dream. A foul taint spreading across Teldrassil has driven these former allies mad. They have desecrated the sanctum, leaving the sleepers unaware that danger threatens their physical bodies.

sections.title: The Tools of Return
sections.body: Athridas Bearmantle needs four sacred relics for the delicate ceremony that can safely awaken the Druids of the Talon. A druid's spirit needs an anchor when returning from the Dream; without one, a sudden awakening can shatter the mind or strand the spirit. The relics lie in chests across the den: the Raven Claw Talisman, the Black Feather Quill, the Sapphire of Sky, and the Rune of Nesting. They are the sleepers' only hope before the Gnarlpine butcher or abduct them.

faq.q: Why can't the druids just be shaken awake?
aliases: why need relics to wake druids
faq.answer: Druidic hibernation is a delicate trance linking the mortal body with the Emerald Dream. Without the protective rites of the Relics of Wakening, an improper awakening can strand a druid's consciousness in the Dream, severed from the body.

faq.q: Who are the Druids of the Talon?
faq.answer: The Druids of the Talon are night elf druids attuned to the sky, able to take the form of storm crows and command the winds. Many entered the deep slumber of the Emerald Dream in Teldrassil's barrow dens.

faq.q: Why are the Gnarlpine furbolgs attacking the barrow den?
aliases: why are furbolgs in the barrow den
faq.answer: A dark corruption is steadily poisoning Teldrassil's wildlife and forests, driving the Gnarlpine tribe to attack. Once peaceful neighbors to the night elves, the corrupted furbolgs now swarm ancient sanctuaries such as Ban'ethil.

faq.q: What are the four relics being recovered?
faq.answer: The four relics are the Raven Claw Talisman, the Black Feather Quill, the Sapphire of Sky, and the Rune of Nesting. Athridas Bearmantle needs them from sacred chests inside Ban'ethil Barrow Den.

Athridas Bearmantle is a night elf stationed at Dolanaar who watches over the surrounding wilds' spiritual health. He organizes efforts against the sudden corruption afflicting the Gnarlpine furbolgs and the barrow dens.

faq.q: Where is Ban'ethil Barrow Den located?
faq.answer: Ban'ethil Barrow Den lies in the hills directly west of Dolanaar, on the boughs of Teldrassil.

angles.text: As a young druid, you see the assault on Ban'ethil as a strike against your Cenarion kin. Securing the relics helps preserve the sacred bridge between mortal soil and the Emerald Dream.
On Teldrassil's boughs, the desecration of a barrow den shows how quickly corruption is warping the Gnarlpine tribe and disturbing the balance of your new home.
